LIT-001.title: Carnival tent - dusk
LIT-001.description: Faded carnival tent lighting at dusk. Peeling paint reveals flickering practical lights, sparse and melancholic. Warm tungsten, heavy shadows, almost no spotlight on stage.

LIT-002.title: Dressing room - backstage
LIT-002.description: Grimy dressing room. Single bare bulb over mirror, harsh and unflattering. Yellow-tinted, tired light that emphasizes age and wear.

LIT-003.title: Alley - late night
LIT-003.description: Dark alley behind theater. Single flickering street light. High contrast shadows, murky pools of light, abandoned atmosphere. The glowing magic item provides only source of hope.

LIT-004.title: Magical realm - wonderland phase
LIT-004.description: Ethereal, luminous light. Soft glowing platforms, crystalline light sources. Colors vibrant and saturated—warm golds, cool silvers, impossible gradients. Light appears to emanate from the world itself.

LIT-005.title: Magical realm - corruption phase
LIT-005.description: Light becomes fragmented and chaotic. Harsh neons mixed with deep shadows. Strobing, disorienting. Colors shift from vibrant to acidic and nauseating.

LIT-006.title: Magical fingers - descent finale
LIT-006.description: Blinding white light from descending fingers. High contrast, almost overexposed. Everything becomes silhouetted and abstract as scrolling accelerates.

CH-001.name: THE RABBIT
CH-001.description: A white rabbit with intelligent, melancholic eyes. Anthropomorphic—walks, talks, smokes. Wears a tailored miniature magician's coat. World-weary expression hides sharp intellect and dry humor. Observant and skeptical despite his circumstances.

wardrobe.head: White fur with slightly grayed ears, alert eyes, expressive face
wardrobe.torso: Tailored black velvet miniature magician's coat, brass buttons, slightly worn at cuffs
wardrobe.hands: White fur with dexterous fingers, capable of holding cigarettes and small objects
wardrobe.legs: White fur, standing upright on hind legs
wardrobe.carried: Cigarette (smoking throughout story), later the magical crystalline object

CH-002.name: THE MAGICIAN
CH-002.role: Aging stage magician, employer and friend
CH-002.description: Tired old magician in a threadbare tuxedo. Once passionate about his craft, now going through motions out of necessity and fading pride. Deep-set tired eyes that still hold a spark of the performer. Moves with mechanical precision—decades of repetition.

wardrobe.head: Gray hair slicked back, weathered face, hollow cheeks
wardrobe.torso: Threadbare black tuxedo with worn silk lapels, white dress shirt yellowed with age, crooked bow tie
wardrobe.hands: Wrinkled, liver spots, long-fingered and graceful despite age, usually clutching the top hat
wardrobe.feet: Scuffed black formal shoes, worn heels
wardrobe.carried: The black top hat (his instrument and livelihood)

CH-003.name: TikTok Dancers (Collective)
CH-003.description: Humanoid figures with impossibly wide smiles, glitching movements. Endlessly repeat the same dance gesture, multiplying exponentially. Their movements are fluid but also jerky—like video glitches. Eyes are vacant and manic.

wardrobe.head: Featureless or generic, wide smile, blank eyes
wardrobe.torso: Generic modern casual wear that blurs and shifts as they multiply
wardrobe.legs: Dancing in place, same choreography over and over

CH-004.name: Flat Earth Cultists (Collective)
CH-004.description: Shadowy figures arguing passionately about gravity and the shape of the world. Standing at impossible angles—some upside-down, some sideways on tilted surfaces. Their body language is aggressive and defensive.

wardrobe.head: Obscured, focusing on expressive gestures
wardrobe.carried: Conspiracy boards, maps that don't make sense

CH-005.name: Instagram Influencers (Collective)
CH-005.role: Manifestation of false enthusiasm and performative culture
CH-005.description: Figures with exaggerated expressions of fake enthusiasm. Hair and makeup unnaturally perfect. Movements are stilted and overly expressive. Preparing bizarre, inedible recipes with forced excitement.

wardrobe.head: Over-styled hair, heavy makeup, frozen smile

CH-006.name: The Magical Fingers
CH-006.role: Manifestation of algorithmic control and endless scrolling
CH-006.description: Enormous, ethereal fingers descending from above like the hand of some digital god. They perform the swiping gesture of endless scrolling with increasing speed. Initially graceful, then frantic and destructive.

wardrobe.head: N/A - only fingers visible
wardrobe.hands: Massive translucent glowing fingers, perfectly manicured
wardrobe.carried: The ability to reorganize reality with each swipe

PRP-001.title: The Top Hat
PRP-001.description: Black silk top hat, the Magician's primary instrument. Worn, faded, but still carries symbolic weight. Serves as the portal between the real world and the magical realm. Later becomes a symbol of the trap the Rabbit refuses to return to.

PRP-002.title: The Crystalline Magic Item
PRP-002.description: Small, undefined crystalline object. Glows with soft inner light. Warm to the touch. Hums with energy. Found in the alley. Activates the hat's true magical properties. Mysterious in origin and purpose—the catalyst for everything.

PRP-003.title: Silk cloth
PRP-003.description: The covering cloth used in the magic trick. Ordinary in the real world, but becomes the veil between realities when combined with the magic item.

PRP-004.title: Cigarette
PRP-004.description: The Rabbit's constant companion. A symbol of his weary acceptance of his situation. Smoked in the alley, in the dressing room, throughout the story. A moment of autonomy in an otherwise controlled existence.

PRP-005.title: Coins on table
PRP-005.description: Meager earnings from the show. Barely enough for rent. Visual representation of the Magician and Rabbit's financial desperation.

PRP-006.title: Velvet cage
PRP-006.description: The Rabbit's stage container. Elegant but confining. A gilded cage that represents the trap of their profession.

PRP-007.title: Conspiracy boards
PRP-007.description: Covered in strings, circles, and incomprehensible connections. Props in the flat earth zone representing the visual language of conspiracy culture.

PRP-008.title: Bizarre food items
PRP-008.description: Melting, impossible recipes. Ingredients that shouldn't exist together. Visual representations of algorithmic content generation and influencer culture.

PRP-009.title: Bookshop/Coffee shop
PRP-009.description: The future refuge of the Rabbit and Magician. A quiet, grounded space away from performance and illusion.

LOC-001.title: Faded carnival tent
LOC-001.description: Third-rate carnival venue. Peeling paint, broken lights, rickety audience seats scattered sparsely. A stage barely elevated. The smell of decay and failed dreams. Represents the graveyard of entertainment.

LOC-002.title: Dressing room backstage
LOC-002.description: Grimy, cramped. Bare bulb over cracked mirror. Makeup table with scattered coins. The Magician's and Rabbit's temporary sanctuary where they count their meager earnings and contemplate existence.

LOC-003.title: Alley behind theater
LOC-003.description: Dark, trash-filled. Two dumpsters. Single flickering street light. Where the Rabbit finds the magic item. Liminal space between the real world and the magical.

LOC-004.title: The Wonderland (Magical Realm - Phase 1)
LOC-004.description: Vast, Fantasia-scale world of floating platforms, spiraling towers of light and sound. Crystalline formations. Ethereal creatures dancing in geometric patterns. Inviting, beautiful, surreal. Initially appears as escape and wonder.

LOC-005.title: The Flat Earth Zone
LOC-005.description: Mountains bend impossibly. Horizons tilt at wrong angles. Figures standing upside-down. A zone dedicated to conspiracy and misinformation. Everything is geometrically wrong.

LOC-006.title: The TikTok Spiral
LOC-006.description: An infinite dance floor where humanoid shapes repeat the same gesture endlessly, faster and faster, multiplying exponentially. A vortex of algorithmic repetition.

LOC-007.title: Area 51 District
LOC-007.description: Cavernous space filled with conspiracy boards, blinking lights, shadowy figures searching in darkness. Whispered overlapping theories. A manifestation of obsession with hidden truths.

LOC-008.title: The Instagram Kitchen
LOC-008.description: Grotesque kitchen where influencers prepare bizarre, inedible recipes with forced enthusiasm. Melting food, impossible combinations. A nauseating carnival of false perfection.

LOC-009.title: The Vortex of Endless Scrolling
LOC-009.description: A blur of images and content. Everything pulls the Rabbit deeper. The world becomes abstract and oppressive. A representation of algorithmic drowning.

LOC-010.title: The Escape—Descending Fingers finale
LOC-010.description: The entire realm convulses as enormous magical fingers descend, swiping across the world. Everything is reorganized and erased. Fantasia-scale chaos. The Rabbit spots the glowing hat in the distance.

LOC-011.title: Quiet bookshop or coffee shop (Epilogue)
LOC-011.description: Years later. Small, peaceful refuge away from stages and illusions. Books or coffee setup. The magic item glows faintly on a high shelf. A new life for the Rabbit and Magician.
